question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH daily_delivered AS (
  SELECT
    d.DATE_DAY,
    d.DAY_NAME,
    DAYOFWEEKISO(d.DATE_DAY) AS WEEKDAY_NUM,
    COUNT_IF(o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE AS d
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER AS o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
  WHERE d.DATE_DAY >= '2025-01-01'::DATE
    AND d.DATE_DAY < '2026-01-01'::DATE
  GROUP BY d.DATE_DAY, d.DAY_NAME
)
SELECT
  DAY_NAME AS WEEKDAY,
  COUNT(*) AS CALENDAR_DATES,
  AVG(DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT) AS AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_DATE
FROM daily_delivered
GROUP BY DAY_NAME, WEEKDAY_NUM
ORDER BY WEEKDAY_NUM

action.answer: Across all calendar dates in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, the average Delivered orders per date were: Mon 9094.365385 (52 dates); Tue 9082.788462 (52); Wed 9053.773585 (53); Thu 9473.653846 (52); Fri 12228.980769 (52); Sat 14486.211538 (52); Sun 13119.134615 (52). Saturday had the highest average, at 14486.211538 Delivered orders per calendar date.
